title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: the adopt-orphans door asks the `__c` judge against the target package; the promotion's suffix block is seal-gated
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XUSbzmMRfCQ13hL4Jffkmqp)_

Fixes #28735

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches the adopt-orphans door or a field spelled `__c` (0 hits for `adopt-orphans`, `reassignOrphanedMetadata` and `[a-z0-9]__c`).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：「收养孤儿元数据」(`POST /api/v1/packages/:id/adopt-orphans`) 现在也问 `__c` 判官：要把一个不属于任何包、带 `x__c` 字段的对象收进普通包（不是 `.custom` 配对包）时，整次收养被拒，一行都不动；收进基础包的 `.custom` 配对包照常放行。另外，草稿发布时的 `__c` 检查对「代码包自带的受封对象」不再先开口，让存储层的 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` 作为唯一答复，和上面两道检查一致。
- **为什么改**：#28564 让保存、恢复、发布、复制、`os validate`、市场安装都拒绝普通包里的 `__c` 字段，唯独收养这道门不问，等于留了一条把 `x__c` 塞进普通包的后路（#28724 合同审查的两条 should-fix）。
- **风险与回滚**：收窄只拦今天没人用的情形：在本 PR 基点实测 `examples/**`、`packages/*/src`（不含测试）里 `[a-z0-9]__c` 字段 0 个（文本命中全在文档注释里）。沿用保存门的 `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 信封，不新增错误码，不动 spec。回滚即 revert，无数据迁移。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 的 `reassignOrphanedMetadata`（第一次 `update` 之前新加的判官块）；同文件 `promoteDraftForPublish` 里 `__c` 块的条件；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.extension-field-suffix.test.ts` 新增的 4b 节和受封用例。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.extension-field-suffix.test.ts`，预期 `Tests 24 passed (24)`（main 上新增的 3 条红）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（合同审查后）。

## What changes

- **The adopt door asks the `__c` judge** (`reassignOrphanedMetadata`, REST `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/adopt-orphans`). After the orphan list is read and before the first storage `update`, every ACTIVE `object` row the adoption would rebind is handed to `judgeExtensionFieldSuffix` as the TARGET package's own object (`{ packageId: targetPackageId, objects }`), the same call `duplicatePackage` makes. Any refused field throws `extensionFieldSuffixRefusalError`: `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, the message case (a)'s sentence, `issues[]` locating each field at `objects.OBJECT.fields.FIELD`. The adoption is refused whole: no row moves and `applyRegistryWriteThrough` never runs. An adoption into the base's `.custom` pair is admitted (a pair's own objects are not judged). An unparseable row body is left to the loop, as `duplicatePackage` leaves it. The type folds through `canonicalMetaType`, as the loop's own registry limb does.
- **Drafts.** Ruling 1 names active rows. An adopted package-less draft is rebound in storage only (unchanged), and when it is promoted the promotion asks the same judge against its binding, so `x__c` still cannot go live in a plain package.
- **The promotion's suffix block is seal-gated** (`promoteDraftForPublish`): `if (draftForGate && singularType === 'object' && !this.isSealedManagedItem(singularType, request.name))`, exactly like the D9.9 block and the namespace-prefix block above it. A sealed draft carrying `x__c` now reaches the store's one `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` / 403 (`repo.promoteDraft` → `assertAllowed`) instead of "rename the field". For a non-object type the judge answered `undefined` already, so adding `singularType === 'object'` to the condition changes nothing else.
- **No new error code, no `packages/spec/**` change, no ui change, no new gate.** Not touched: `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`, `stored-row-binding.ts`, `withRowBinding`, the automation boot pull.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/28735-adopt-orphans-extension-field-suffix.md`: `minor` on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (kind `narrowed`), with the BREAKING banner, both declaration lines, the migration paragraph and the ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition.

**Why `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`.** An adoption into a plain package that admitted an object row carrying `x__c` is now refused: one more write door applies the requirement #28564 declared `narrowed` at its doors. Nothing an author could save before is refused at the save door (the package-less save is unchanged); what narrows is the set of package contents the adopt door can produce.

## Tests

New in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.extension-field-suffix.test.ts` (the #28564 file, its stub engine and helpers):

- **§4b, adopt-orphans.** (1) A package-less active `probe_env` with `x__c`, saved through the real save door (not judged: no package), adopted into the plain `app.probe-bound`: refused with case (a)'s envelope and sentence, `issues` path `objects.probe_env.fields.x__c`; `engine.update` never called, `applyRegistryWriteThrough` never called; the store reads back the row still package-less and active. (2) Mixed: a clean `probe_clean` beside `probe_env` (`x__c`) into the plain package: refused whole; both rows stay package-less; no write-through. (3) CONTROL: the same `x__c` row adopted into `app.probe-bound.custom` is admitted (`success: true`, `reassignedCount: 1`) and the row reads back bound to the pair; a clean row into the plain package moves too.
- **§3b, the seal gate.** The stub registry ships `probe_sealed` (`getArtifactItem` answers `_packageId: com.acme.shipper`, `_provenance: package`), so `isSealedManagedItem('object','probe_sealed')` holds. A draft of it carrying `x__c`, bound to the plain package, is staged as a row stored before the gate (the save door refuses that draft first, `refusePackagedBaseOverride`). `publishMetaItem` answers `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` / 403, and the draft is still a draft. The gate is reachable this way only (a pre-gate stored row); no public save produces that draft today.

<details><summary>Red on base, green on head</summary>

- **Base** (`protocol.ts` from `db357f6d`, the new tests at head): `Tests 3 failed | 21 passed (24)`. The seal pin: `expected { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', …(1) } to deeply equal { Object (code, status) }`. The two adopt refusals: `expected null to be an instance of Error` (the adoption succeeded). The `.custom` CONTROL is green on base and head, as a control should be. Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- protocol.ts`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Head**: `Tests 24 passed (24)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one-off, from committed HEAD, `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`)</summary>

The suite imports `./protocol.js` from source, so no build sits between mutation and run.

- **Adopt call removed.** `if (suffixRefusals.length > 0) throw extensionFieldSuffixRefusalError(suffixRefusals);` in `reassignOrphanedMetadata` replaced with `void suffixRefusals; /* ABLATE_28735_ADOPT */`: anchor 1 → 0, blob `065792a3d3d0` → `618118ae6818`. `Tests 2 failed | 22 passed (24)`: the two adopt refusals. Restored: blob equals HEAD `065792a3d3d0`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Seal gate removed.** The promotion's suffix-block condition replaced with `if (draftForGate /* ABLATE_28735_SEAL */)`: anchor 1 → 0, blob `065792a3d3d0` → `7a4b2a52267f`. `Tests 1 failed | 23 passed (24)`: the seal pin. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The other two judges (ruling 2).** Not added. The namespace-prefix judge (`objectNamespacePrefixViolation`) and the owner judge (`permissionSetOwnerBindingRefusal`) are skipped at this door too. See the report's `open_questions` for whether they should ride this call and what that costs.
- **The judge module's door list.** `protocol-extension-field-suffix.ts`'s header lists the doors that call the judge and does not yet name the adopt door. That file is outside the claim's file surface, so it is left; the call site's comment and `reassignOrphanedMetadata`'s header carry the reference.
- **Narrowing count.** 0 fields spelled `[a-z0-9]__c` in `examples/**` and `packages/*/src` outside tests (`git grep -nE '[a-z0-9]__c\b'`, 10 textual hits, all doc comments, including the two this PR adds), so no package-less `object` row in the tree carries one.
